policy.cold_definition: A new isolated project and process with global package caches retained.
policy.warm_definition: The same installed project after the cold setup, with a new command process.

neutral_matching.rule: Every participant receives the same domain task, fixture, edit, defect, fix, and required observations; only native scaffold and command spelling may differ.

comparison.rule: A comparison is scored only when both participants have measured values and complete command, observation, and artifact evidence for that leaf.

loc.policy: Count UTF-8 source lines after excluding blank lines and lines whose first non-whitespace token is //; keep source files and policy fixed for every participant.

comparison.loc_policy: Apply the same nonblank, non-line-comment count to the peer source inventory; retain the inventory and exclusions in the receipt.

recorded_program.source_and_workflow_contract: Use the declared source inventory, edit recipe, defect/repair recipe, and workflow markers for Jet and the peer. Never scaffold, download, or score a participant without direct evidence.
